DATUM-BIAS CAVEAT (safety-of-navigation): The EOT20 MSL→LAT separation (median 1.131 m applied) is unvalidated at this site. The nearest research-quality gauge (Mina Sulman, Bahrain, ~340 km NW) shows EOT20 under-estimating the separation by 0.214 m; IF that transfers to Marawah, charted LAT depths would be up to ~0.2 m TOO DEEP (shoals under-reported — the navigation-unsafe direction). Sign and magnitude at Marawah are UNKNOWN; no correction has been applied (a manufactured shift from one distant embayment is not defensible). This possible systematic bias sits within the CATZOC C ±2.19 m allowance and the >0.8 m TVU95 headroom, so the CATZOC C reconnaissance classification is unaffected. Mariners must apply full CATZOC C under-keel clearance and treat charted LAT depths as possibly ~0.2 m optimistic until a local tide gauge validates the datum.

results.source_note: Abu Dhabi shallow VHR campaign (UAE/Morocco multisite closeout). Sentinel-2 L2A → Lyzenga + Stumpf log-ratios, robust-linear (Huber) calibration to ICESat-2 ATL24 photons under spatial-block cross-validation (≥8 blocks, ≥500 m buffer, 3-seed pooled OOF). GRADE = RELATIVE: shipped raster is the dimensionless Stumpf morphology index (0–1), NOT absolute depth. Downsampled committable preview (~700 px) of the gitignored full-res product Very_HR_Results/abudhabi_shallow/marawah/marawah_sdb_depth.tif. NO validated depth rank (strong spectral signal but regression-to-mean; seagrass/sand bottom-type variance).

metrics.product_type: relative Stumpf morphology index (0–1), NOT satellite-derived absolute depth
metrics.validation_status: RELATIVE (NO validated depth rank) — morphology index only, photon-referenced, NO in-situ

honesty_card.headline: RELATIVE reconnaissance product. ATL24-calibrated robust-linear fit achieves RMSE 1.84 m, R² -0.104, decile slope 0.046 (shuffle +135.2%, n=445) — but the shipped raster is a relative Stumpf morphology index (0–1), NOT validated absolute depth.
honesty_card.depth_rank: NONE — no validated depth rank (R²<0); bottom-type albedo variance / no spectral depth signal
honesty_card.ceiling: Bottom-type (seagrass/sand mosaic) albedo variance caps the pooled decile slope below the CALIBRATED gate (≥0.70). Per-class within-uniform-bottom slopes reached 0.72–0.74 at eastern_mangroves but were a small-N artifact under an 8-seed robust gate.
honesty_card.comparability: NOT comparable to validated regions (Old Mussafah 0.92 m, Khalifa multibeam). RECONNAISSANCE / RELATIVE grade — morphology only.
honesty_card.campaign_verdict: 8-round UAE+Morocco optical+wave SDB campaign CONVERGED: no survey-grade (CALIBRATED) skill anywhere; honest ceiling is RECONNAISSANCE. Further improvement needs NEW DATA (commercial VHR multispectral, in-situ multibeam, ICESat-2 densification, airborne lidar).
honesty_card.vhr_caveat: Guided ×2 upsample (10 m → ~5 m) is spatial detail only; carries NO independent depth skill.

results.name: Yas Lagoon -- RELATIVE morphology SDB (ATL24 reconnaissance)
results.units: relative Stumpf morphology index (0-1) -- NOT metres. The shipped raster is bottom morphology only; no validated absolute depth.
results.source_note: Abu Dhabi shallow VHR campaign -- new-site delivery run (Yas/Al Raha sheltered lagoon). Sentinel-2 L2A (2024-2025 median) -> Lyzenga + Stumpf log-ratios, robust-linear (Huber) calibration to ICESat-2 ATL24 photons under spatial-block cross-validation (>=8 blocks, >=500 m buffer, 3-seed pooled OOF, n_test=575). GRADE = RELATIVE: shipped raster is the dimensionless Stumpf morphology index (0-1), NOT absolute depth. Downsampled committable preview (~700 px) of the gitignored full-res product Very_HR_Results/abudhabi_shallow/yas_lagoon/yas_lagoon_sdb_depth.tif. NO validated depth rank (strong spectral signal, shuffle +95%, but pooled R2<0 / slope 0.42; Yas/Al Raha sheltered lagoon, seagrass/sand bottom-type variance caps depth rank).
